integrity: Analytic all-parameter proof with an exact starting expectation attributed to the primary source; an independently executable standard-library checker is included. Finite tests do not establish universal quantifiers.
scientific_limitations: Uniform independent points on a max-norm torus; expected vertex-averaged bias only; integer dimension and n>=3; separate fixed-size limits, no uniform joint n,m limit. Historical priority has not been independently established.
title: A unique optimal geometric radius for the expected friendship paradox, with two boundary limits
